description: This Swift source file defines the GatewayNodeSession actor which manages websocket connections, handles node invocation requests, manages connection state, and communicates with a backend server for a shared OpenClawKit application. It includes functionality for URL canonicalization, request invocation with timeouts, event handling, and server communication.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSession
classes.description: An actor that manages websocket sessions with a node, handles requests, events, and maintains connection state.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeout
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous invocation with a specified timeout, ensuring that the timeout can preempt long-running tasks.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the server, initializes the session, and handles reconnection logic.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Shuts down the current connection and resets the session state.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests the server to send the current canvas capability and updates the local URL accordingly.
